title: QA Mobile App Automation Engineer
description:
**Automation, mobile apps, iOS, Android, Java, appium, playwright, selenium** 





 ﻿
 
 We are seeking Automation engineer with strong experience in mobile app automation , website and POS automation. This role will focus on building and maintaining automation frameworks that validate end\-to\-end customer ordering workflows across mobile apps, websites, and POS systems. The ideal candidate combines software engineering skills with QA automation expertise and has hands\-on experience automating iOS, Android, web applications, and device\-integrated systems.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks for:
* **Mobile applications (iOS and Android)**
* **Websites and ordering portals**
* **POS workflows**
* Build mobile automation test suites using Appium
* Develop web automation using modern tools such as Playwright or Selenium
* Automate POS ordering workflows and store integrations
* Create API automation tests for backend services
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Maintain automation stability, reliability, and execution speed
* Collaborate with developers, product teams, and DevOps engineers
* Participate in test strategy, test design, and automation planning



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* 5–8 years of QA automation or SDET experience
* Strong programming skills in one of:
* Java
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Python
* Groovy
* Hands\-on experience automating:
* Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
* Web applications
* POS workflows or device\-based systems
* Experience with:
* Appium (mobile automation)
* Playwright or Selenium (web automation)
* Jmeter or any performance testing tools
* Api testing
* Experience with API automation
* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with automation framework design patterns (POM, modular frameworks)



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience testing digital ordering platforms or retail/QSR systems
* Experience with React Native mobile apps
* Experience using device farms (Browser Stack, AWS Device Farm)
* Knowledge of Git\-based development workflows
* Familiarity with MCP\-style test design and automation workflows
* Experience using Generative AI tools for automation development
* Experience using AI\-assisted coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, etc.)



**Nice\-to\-Have Domain Experience** 



* POS systems and store ordering workflows
* Menu and pricing systems
* Payment integrations
* End\-to\-end order lifecycle validation
* Retail or QSR technology platforms

**Overview**
 Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world\-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry\-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting\-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**
 Embed with customer stakeholders to understand business workflows, constraints, and success metrics; translate ambiguous needs into clear requirements, solution hypotheses, and sprint deliverables for GenAI/agentic scenarios.
   

  

 Design and
 **implement** 
 agentic and GenAI solutions on Microsoft platforms (e.g., Dynamics 365, M365 Copilots, Power Platform, Azure) including integrations, APIs, and automations that accelerate adoption and deliver measurable outcomes.

 8\+ years’ experience delivering enterprise\-scale solutions on Microsoft platforms (Dynamics 365 / M365 Copilot/ Power Platform / Azure), including integration, security, and deployment in customer environments.

 Proven experience delivering

 across the full delivery lifecycle, including requirement ambiguity, development, deployment, and post‑go‑live stabilization.
   

  

 Proven delivery of Dynamics 365 CE/Power Platform solutions, M365 Copilot Solutions, plus experience building AI\-infused workflows (recommendations, summarization, case routing, contact center assist, sales/service copilots) with production\-grade engineering practices.
   

  

 Experience building or extending solutions involving
 **Copilots, AI‑assisted workflows, or intelligent automation**

 Certifications and/or experience in Azure Solutions, Dynamics 365, M365 Copilot and Power Platform; exposure to Azure AI services and GenAI solution patterns is a strong plus.Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, and operational readiness (observability, incident response) strongly preferred—especially for AI systems.
   

  

 Desirable experience includes Azure solution development, Contact Center solutions, Copilot Studio, and building GenAI/agentic experiences (tool\-use orchestration, retrieval grounding, evaluation/quality loops, safety/guardrails).Excellent communication: explain AI behaviors, risks, and tradeoffs to technical and non\-technical stakeholders; drive alignment from ambiguity to execution.
   

  

 Trusted customer\-facing engineering presence: collaborate deeply, pair\-build with customer teams, and transfer knowledge to ensure long\-term maintainability.Proactively identify and mitigate risks, including AI\-specific failure modes (grounding gaps, unsafe outputs, data leakage) and enterprise constraints (security, privacy, compliance).

Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow and profoundly impact health for humanity.

**Location**
 Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Reports To**
 Director, Product Engineering / ICC
   

  

 Position Overview
   

  

 Johnson \& Johnson is seeking a highly capable Forward Deployed Engineer, Full Stack, Lead Engineer to work directly with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering partners to design, build, deploy, and operationalize modern digital solutions in real\-world enterprise environments.
   

  

 This role will serve as a hands\-on technical lead embedded close to users and product teams, translating ambiguous business problems into secure, scalable, and production\-ready full stack solutions. The successful candidate will bridge product strategy, solution architecture, engineering execution, deployment, adoption, and operational support across Clinical Development, R\&D, Medical Affairs, and enterprise technology capabilities.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings deep full stack engineering expertise, strong systems thinking, customer\-facing problem solving, cloud\-native delivery experience, DevSecOps discipline, and the ability to rapidly prototype, harden, and scale solutions within regulated enterprise technology environments.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Forward Deployed Engineering Leadership
   

  

* Act as the technical lead for customer\-embedded delivery efforts, owning solution discovery, design, build, deployment, and adoption from concept to production.
* Lead by influence across product managers, architects, engineers, data teams, AI teams, cybersecurity, quality, and business stakeholders.
* Translate complex and evolving business needs into actionable technical designs, prototypes, integration patterns, and delivery plans.
* Mentor engineers on solution design, secure coding, debugging, technical decision\-making, and production\-readiness practices.


 Full Stack Product Engineering
   

  

* Design and build modern web applications, APIs, services, workflow tools, dashboards, portals, automation components, and integration layers.
* Rapidly prototype solutions with users, validate value, iterate based on feedback, and convert prototypes into maintainable production\-grade applications.
* Own implementation across front\-end, back\-end, API, database, identity, integration, observability, and deployment layers.
* Ensure solutions are scalable, secure, accessible, performant, compliant, and aligned with enterprise architecture and platform standards.


 Deployment, Integration \& Enterprise Platforms
   

  

* Deploy and integrate solutions within complex enterprise environments, including legacy systems, cloud platforms, identity services, data platforms, and third\-party applications.
* Apply cloud\-native patterns, microservices, API\-first design, event\-driven integration, containerization, and managed services where appropriate.
* Troubleshoot production issues, resolve integration blockers, optimize performance, and address edge cases in live business workflows.
* Capture deployment learnings and convert them into reusable engineering patterns, product improvements, accelerators, and reference architectures.


 DevSecOps \& Operational Excellence
   

  

* Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, quality gates, security scans, infrastructure automation, and release management practices.
* Establish operational KPIs covering reliability, performance, deployment frequency, incident trends, and service health.
* Partner with cybersecurity, privacy, and quality teams to ensure secure software development lifecycle practices.
* Drive root cause analysis, technical debt reduction, application rationalization, and continuous platform improvement.


 Stakeholder \& Product Delivery
   

  

* Run discovery workshops, technical deep dives, and solution design sessions with business users, product owners, architects, and delivery teams.
* Communicate trade\-offs, risks, technical options, and delivery progress clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Partner with product teams to convert field insights into backlog items, platform enhancements, roadmap inputs, and adoption strategies.
* Balance rapid delivery, business value, user adoption, security, compliance, quality, and long\-term maintainability.


 Compliance, Security \& Quality
   

  

* Ensure applications comply with applicable enterprise security, privacy, quality, accessibility, and regulatory requirements.
* Support delivery practices aligned with GxP, Computer System Validation (CSV), GDPR, HIPAA, and internal J\&J technology standards where applicable.
* Maintain audit\-ready engineering documentation, traceability, and release evidence for regulated applications.
* Promote responsible use of data and AI\-enabled capabilities within application experiences.

 Developer to drive the design and implementation of our next\-generation Mission Planning Software. This role focuses on building high\-performance, low\-latency tactical control dashboards where visual clarity, real\-time responsiveness, and absolute stability are critical.

* Lead UI Architecture: Own the end\-to\-end user interface architecture of proprietary Mission Planning Systems using C\+\+, WIN32 and the Qt framework.
